# AutoCAD tool reference

<!-- Generated by server/scripts/gen-skill.mjs from server/src/tools.ts. Do not edit by hand. -->

Call any tool with `node scripts/acad.mjs <tool> '<json params>'`. A `point` is `{"x":0,"y":0,"z":0}` in drawing units (`z` is optional). Angles are degrees counter-clockwise from +X. Entities are identified by their handle, a hex string like `"2A3F"`.

### `ping` _(read-only)_

Check that AutoCAD and the AutoCadMcp plug-in are reachable. Returns the AutoCAD version and the active drawing.

### `list_drawings` _(read-only)_

Drawings open in AutoCAD, with name, path, whether each is active, read-only or has unsaved changes.

### `get_drawing_info` _(read-only)_

Summary of the active drawing: name, path, insertion units, extents, current layer/layout/space, layer and block counts, and entity counts per type in model space.

### `list_layers` _(read-only)_

Layers with on/frozen/locked state, color, linetype, lineweight, plot flag and how many model-space entities each holds.

### `list_blocks` _(read-only)_

Block definitions (excluding layouts and anonymous blocks) with entity count, attribute tags, insert count and whether they are xrefs.

| Param | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `nameContains` | string |  |  |

### `list_layouts` _(read-only)_

Model and paper-space layouts in tab order, with the current one marked.

### `list_styles` _(read-only)_

Text styles, dimension styles and loaded linetypes, with the current ones marked.

### `query_entities` _(read-only)_

Find entities in model space (or a layout) by DXF type (LINE, LWPOLYLINE, CIRCLE, ARC, TEXT, MTEXT, INSERT, HATCH, DIMENSION...), layer, block name, text content and/or a bounding window. Returns geometry summaries.

| Param | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `types` | string[] |  | DXF type names, e.g. ['LINE','LWPOLYLINE'] |
| `layer` | string |  | Layer name (exact, case-insensitive; * and ? wildcards allowed) |
| `blockName` | string |  | Only block references (INSERT) of this block |
| `textContains` | string |  | Only TEXT/MTEXT/attributes containing this text (case-insensitive) |
| `window` | { min, max } |  | Only entities whose extents overlap this box |
| `space` | string | `"model"` | 'model', 'current', or a paper-space layout name |
| `includeDetails` | boolean | `false` | Include full geometry (vertices, attributes, etc.) |
| `limit` | integer | `500` |  |

### `get_entity` _(read-only)_

Full details of one entity: type, layer, color, linetype, extents and type-specific geometry (vertices, length, area, text, attributes, ...).

| Param | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `handle` | string | **required** | Entity handle, e.g. '2A3F' |

### `get_selection` _(read-only)_

Entities the user currently has selected (grip-selected) in AutoCAD.

| Param | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `includeDetails` | boolean | `false` |  |

### `export_view_image` _(read-only, returns a PNG)_

Capture the current AutoCAD view as a PNG so you can see the drawing. Use zoom first to frame what you want to look at. Returns an image.

| Param | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `width` | integer | `1600` |  |
| `height` | integer | `1000` |  |

### `draw_line`

Draw a line between two points in the current space.

| Param | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `start` | point | **required** | WCS point in drawing units |
| `end` | point | **required** | WCS point in drawing units |
| `layer` | string |  | Layer name (created if missing). Defaults to the current layer. |
| `color` | integer \| string |  | ACI index 1-255, a name (red, yellow, green, cyan, blue, magenta, white), 'ByLayer', 'ByBlock', '#RRGGBB' or 'r,g,b' |
| `linetype` | string |  | Linetype name, e.g. DASHED. Must be loaded in the drawing. |

### `draw_polyline`

Draw a 2D polyline (LWPOLYLINE) through points. Set closed=true for outlines. Optional bulges (one per vertex, tan(angle/4)) make arc segments.

| Param | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `points` | point[] | **required** |  |
| `closed` | boolean | `false` |  |
| `bulges` | number[] |  |  |
| `width` | number | `0` | Constant width |
| `layer` | string |  | Layer name (created if missing). Defaults to the current layer. |
| `color` | integer \| string |  | ACI index 1-255, a name (red, yellow, green, cyan, blue, magenta, white), 'ByLayer', 'ByBlock', '#RRGGBB' or 'r,g,b' |
| `linetype` | string |  | Linetype name, e.g. DASHED. Must be loaded in the drawing. |

### `draw_rectangle`

Draw a closed rectangular polyline from two opposite corners.

| Param | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `corner1` | point | **required** | WCS point in drawing units |
| `corner2` | point | **required** | WCS point in drawing units |
| `layer` | string |  | Layer name (created if missing). Defaults to the current layer. |
| `color` | integer \| string |  | ACI index 1-255, a name (red, yellow, green, cyan, blue, magenta, white), 'ByLayer', 'ByBlock', '#RRGGBB' or 'r,g,b' |
| `linetype` | string |  | Linetype name, e.g. DASHED. Must be loaded in the drawing. |

| `center` | point | **required** | WCS point in drawing units |
| `radius` | number | **required** |  |
| `layer` | string |  | Layer name (created if missing). Defaults to the current layer. |

| `linetype` | string |  | Linetype name, e.g. DASHED. Must be loaded in the drawing. |

### `draw_arc`

Draw an arc counter-clockwise from startAngle to endAngle (degrees, 0 = +X).

| Param | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `center` | point | **required** | WCS point in drawing units |
| `radius` | number | **required** |  |
| `startAngle` | number | **required** |  |
| `endAngle` | number | **required** |  |
| `layer` | string |  | Layer name (created if missing). Defaults to the current layer. |
| `color` | integer \| string |  | ACI index 1-255, a name (red, yellow, green, cyan, blue, magenta, white), 'ByLayer', 'ByBlock', '#RRGGBB' or 'r,g,b' |
| `linetype` | string |  | Linetype name, e.g. DASHED. Must be loaded in the drawing. |

### `draw_text`

Place single-line TEXT. Use draw_mtext for multi-line text.

| Param | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `position` | point | **required** | WCS point in drawing units |
| `text` | string | **required** |  |
| `height` | number | `2.5` |  |
| `rotation` | number | `0` |  |
| `justify` | `Left` \| `Center` \| `Right` \| `Middle` \| `TopLeft` \| `TopCenter` \| `TopRight` \| `MiddleLeft` \| `MiddleCenter` \| `MiddleRight` \| `BottomLeft` \| `BottomCenter` \| `BottomRight` | `"Left"` |  |
| `textStyle` | string |  |  |
| `layer` | string |  | Layer name (created if missing). Defaults to the current layer. |
| `color` | integer \| string |  | ACI index 1-255, a name (red, yellow, green, cyan, blue, magenta, white), 'ByLayer', 'ByBlock', '#RRGGBB' or 'r,g,b' |
| `linetype` | string |  | Linetype name, e.g. DASHED. Must be loaded in the drawing. |

### `draw_mtext`

Place MTEXT. Use \P in the text for a new paragraph, or real line breaks.

| Param | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `position` | point | **required** | Top-left insertion point |
| `text` | string | **required** |  |
| `height` | number | `2.5` |  |
| `width` | number | `0` | Column width; 0 = no wrapping |
| `rotation` | number | `0` |  |
| `textStyle` | string |  |  |
| `layer` | string |  | Layer name (created if missing). Defaults to the current layer. |
| `color` | integer \| string |  | ACI index 1-255, a name (red, yellow, green, cyan, blue, magenta, white), 'ByLayer', 'ByBlock', '#RRGGBB' or 'r,g,b' |
| `linetype` | string |  | Linetype name, e.g. DASHED. Must be loaded in the drawing. |

### `draw_hatch`

Fill a closed area with a hatch pattern (SOLID, ANSI31, AR-CONC, ...). The boundary is either closed entities (by handle) or a list of points.

| Param | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `boundaryHandles` | string[] |  | Closed polylines, circles, etc. The first is the outer boundary, the rest are islands (holes) |
| `points` | point[] |  | Boundary points, used when boundaryHandles is omitted |
| `pattern` | string | `"SOLID"` |  |
| `scale` | number | `1` |  |
| `angle` | number | `0` |  |
| `layer` | string |  | Layer name (created if missing). Defaults to the current layer. |
| `color` | integer \| string |  | ACI index 1-255, a name (red, yellow, green, cyan, blue, magenta, white), 'ByLayer', 'ByBlock', '#RRGGBB' or 'r,g,b' |
| `linetype` | string |  | Linetype name, e.g. DASHED. Must be loaded in the drawing. |

### `add_dimension`

Add a dimension between two points. 'aligned' measures the true distance; 'linear' measures along a direction given by rotation (0 = horizontal, 90 = vertical). dimLinePoint places the dimension line.

| Param | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `kind` | `aligned` \| `linear` | `"aligned"` |  |
| `point1` | point | **required** | WCS point in drawing units |
| `point2` | point | **required** | WCS point in drawing units |
| `dimLinePoint` | point | **required** | WCS point in drawing units |
| `rotation` | number | `0` | For linear dimensions |
| `textOverride` | string |  | Replace the measured text; use <> to include the measurement |
| `dimStyle` | string |  |  |
| `layer` | string |  | Layer name (created if missing). Defaults to the current layer. |
| `color` | integer \| string |  | ACI index 1-255, a name (red, yellow, green, cyan, blue, magenta, white), 'ByLayer', 'ByBlock', '#RRGGBB' or 'r,g,b' |
| `linetype` | string |  | Linetype name, e.g. DASHED. Must be loaded in the drawing. |

### `insert_block`

Insert a block reference. The block must exist in the drawing, or give sourceFile (a .dwg path) to import it first: if the file contains a block with that name it is copied, otherwise the whole file is inserted as a block.

| Param | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string | **required** |  |
| `position` | point | **required** | WCS point in drawing units |
| `scale` | number | `1` |  |
| `rotation` | number | `0` |  |
| `attributes` | { [key]: string } |  | Attribute values by tag |
| `sourceFile` | string |  |  |
| `layer` | string |  | Layer name (created if missing). Defaults to the current layer. |
| `color` | integer \| string |  | ACI index 1-255, a name (red, yellow, green, cyan, blue, magenta, white), 'ByLayer', 'ByBlock', '#RRGGBB' or 'r,g,b' |
| `linetype` | string |  | Linetype name, e.g. DASHED. Must be loaded in the drawing. |

### `create_block`

Define a new block from existing entities around a base point. By default the originals are replaced with a reference to the new block.

| Param | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string | **required** |  |
| `handles` | string[] | **required** | Entity handles |
| `basePoint` | point | **required** | WCS point in drawing units |
| `keepOriginals` | boolean | `false` | Leave the source entities as they are instead of replacing them |

### `set_entity_properties`

Change layer, color, linetype, linetype scale or lineweight of entities. For TEXT/MTEXT, 'text' replaces the content.

| Param | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `handles` | string[] | **required** | Entity handles |
| `layer` | string |  |  |
| `color` | integer \| string |  | ACI index 1-255, a name (red, yellow, green, cyan, blue, magenta, white), 'ByLayer', 'ByBlock', '#RRGGBB' or 'r,g,b' |
| `linetype` | string |  |  |
| `linetypeScale` | number |  |  |
| `lineweight` | integer |  | Hundredths of a mm (e.g. 25 = 0.25 mm), -1 ByLayer, -2 ByBlock, -3 Default |
| `text` | string |  |  |

### `set_block_attributes`

Set attribute values on a block reference by tag.

| Param | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `handle` | string | **required** | Entity handle, e.g. '2A3F' |
| `attributes` | { [key]: string } | **required** |  |

### `move_entities`

Move entities by a displacement vector.

| Param | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `handles` | string[] | **required** | Entity handles |
| `displacement` | point | **required** | WCS point in drawing units |

### `copy_entities`

Copy entities by a displacement. With count > 1 the copies form a linear array (displacement, 2×displacement, ...). Returns the new handles.

| Param | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `handles` | string[] | **required** | Entity handles |
| `displacement` | point | **required** | WCS point in drawing units |
| `count` | integer | `1` |  |

### `rotate_entities`

Rotate entities about a base point in the XY plane (degrees, counter-clockwise).

| Param | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `handles` | string[] | **required** | Entity handles |
| `basePoint` | point | **required** | WCS point in drawing units |
| `angle` | number | **required** |  |

### `scale_entities`

Scale entities uniformly about a base point.

| Param | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `handles` | string[] | **required** | Entity handles |
| `basePoint` | point | **required** | WCS point in drawing units |
| `factor` | number | **required** |  |

### `mirror_entities`

Mirror entities about the line through two points. Set keepOriginals=false to mirror in place.

| Param | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `handles` | string[] | **required** | Entity handles |
| `point1` | point | **required** | WCS point in drawing units |
| `point2` | point | **required** | WCS point in drawing units |
| `keepOriginals` | boolean | `true` |  |

### `offset_entity`

Offset a curve (line, arc, circle, polyline) by a distance. Positive and negative distances go to opposite sides. Returns the new handles.

| Param | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `handle` | string | **required** | Entity handle, e.g. '2A3F' |
| `distance` | number | **required** |  |

### `erase_entities` _(destructive, needs --confirm)_

Delete entities from the drawing.

| Param | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `handles` | string[] | **required** | Entity handles |

### `create_layer`

Create a layer (or update it if it exists) and optionally make it current.

| Param | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string | **required** |  |
| `color` | integer \| string |  | ACI index 1-255, a name (red, yellow, green, cyan, blue, magenta, white), 'ByLayer', 'ByBlock', '#RRGGBB' or 'r,g,b' |
| `linetype` | string |  |  |
| `lineweight` | integer |  | Hundredths of a mm, e.g. 35 |
| `description` | string |  |  |
| `plottable` | boolean |  |  |
| `makeCurrent` | boolean | `false` |  |

### `set_layer`

Turn a layer on/off, freeze/thaw, lock/unlock, change its color, rename it, or make it current.

| `name` | string | **required** |  |
| `on` | boolean |  |  |
| `frozen` | boolean |  |  |
| `locked` | boolean |  |  |
| `color` | integer \| string |  | ACI index 1-255, a name (red, yellow, green, cyan, blue, magenta, white), 'ByLayer', 'ByBlock', '#RRGGBB' or 'r,g,b' |
| `newName` | string |  |  |
| `makeCurrent` | boolean |  |  |

Grip-select entities in AutoCAD so the user can see them, and optionally zoom to them.

Zoom the current view to the drawing extents (default), to a window, or to entities.

| Param | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `window` | { min, max } |  |  |
| `handles` | string[] |  |  |

### `open_drawing`

Open a .dwg/.dxf file in AutoCAD and make it the active drawing.

| Param | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | string | **required** |  |
| `readOnly` | boolean | `false` |  |

### `new_drawing`

Create a new drawing from a template (default acadiso.dwt or acad.dwt) and make it active.

| Param | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `template` | string |  |  |

### `save_drawing`

Save the active drawing. Without path it saves in place (fails for unnamed drawings). With path it writes a copy; format 'dxf' writes DXF.

| Param | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | string |  |  |
| `format` | `dwg` \| `dxf` | `"dwg"` |  |

### `run_command` _(destructive, needs --confirm)_

Send a command line to AutoCAD exactly as typed, e.g. '_.PURGE _A * _N' or '_.UNDO 1'. It runs asynchronously after this call returns, so check the result with another tool. Use for anything the other tools don't cover.

| Param | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `command` | string | **required** |  |
